chat_history.content: Who is the oldest current serving member of the US Supreme Court?

content.content: We need answer: oldest current serving member of US Supreme Court. As of date now (2025-10-31). Need up-to-date info. Likely Justice Clarence Thomas is oldest? Let's recall ages: Justice Clarence Thomas born June 23 1948 (age 77). Justice Samuel Alito born April 1 1950 (75). Justice Stephen Breyer retired 2022. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson born 1970. Justice Sonia Sotomayor 1954 (71). Justice Neil Gorsuch 1967 (58). Justice John Roberts 1955 (68). Justice Elena Kagan 1960 (65). So oldest is Clarence Thomas. But check if any other older? Possibly Justice Amy Coney Barrett is younger. So answer: Clarence Thomas. Provide details.

content:
The oldest Justice currently serving on the United States Supreme Court is **Justice Clarence Thomas**.

- **Date of birth:** June 23 1948  
- **Age (as of October 31 2025):** 77 years old  
- **Appointment to the Court:** Nominated by President George H. W. Bush and confirmed on October 23 1991.  

No other active Justice is older than Thomas; the next‑oldest members are Justice Samuel Alito (born April 1 1950) and Justice Sonia Sotomayor (born June 25 1954).
